name: The Westin Punta Cana Resort & Club
positioning: Beachfront Westin on Playa Blanca within the 15,000-acre Puntacana Resort and Club, officially The Westin Puntacana Resort, with an infinity pool, two golf courses and an ecological reserve
best_for: Golfers who want the Corales and La Cana courses
Families wanting a kids club and water sports
Active travelers who want tennis, padel, yoga and nature tours

facts.text: The hotel is located on the beaches of Playa Blanca.
Puntacana Resort was founded in the early 1970s by Frank Rainieri.
Puntacana Resort was created as a sustainable, low-density resort protecting coral reefs, mangroves and forests.
Rooms and suites have views of the Caribbean Sea, lush greenery or pools.
Rooms have tile floors, a soothing color palette and natural elements.
P.B. Dye designed the 27-hole La Cana golf course.
Racquet sports facilities offer tennis, padel and pickleball with professional coaching.
Water sports include kiteboarding, scuba diving, fishing, kayaks and paddle boarding.
Yoga sessions are held to the sound of the waves.
The Kids Club is for young guests ages 4 to 12.
Arena Beach Club is located in front of turquoise waters and a coral reef.

highlights.text: The resort is part of the 15,000-acre Puntacana Resort and Club, which has 3 miles of white-sand beaches.
An expansive infinity pool faces the Caribbean, with turquoise waters at the doorstep.
Tom Fazio's Corales course has six holes along the ocean with forced carries over coral cliffs.
Guests can wake up on a private balcony overlooking the pool and the ocean.
A guided tour of the ecological reserve covers a beekeeping project and conservation of Ridgway's Hawks and the Rhinoceros Iguana.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
Activity calendars may vary by season.
WhataHotel notes the large resort may feel crowded during peak seasons.
